create_monolingual_dataset: create a MonolingualDataset wrapping a torch dataset with sentence sizes and a vocabulary
collate_samples: collate a list of monolingual samples into a padded mini-batch tensor dictionary
make_source_target: build source and target tensors from future and past shifted sentence targets
filter_target_vocab: filter target tokens to replace out-of-vocabulary indices with the unknown token
get_ordered_indices: get an ordered list of dataset indices sorted by size for batching
